# Skyulf

> Skyulf is an open-source, self-hosted visual MLOps platform and Python library (skyulf-core, Apache-2.0) for building scikit-learn pipelines you can trust: automated EDA, data-leakage checks, background training and tuning, experiment comparison, model registry, deployment and drift monitoring.

- Website: https://www.skyulf.com/
- Live demo (no signup): https://api.skyulf.com/
- Source: https://github.com/flyingriverhorse/Skyulf
- Library on PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/skyulf-core/  (`pip install skyulf-core`)
- Docs: https://www.skyulf.com/manual/index.html

## Key facts
- Platform (backend + canvas): AGPLv3. Library (skyulf-core): Apache 2.0.
- Python 3.12; built on scikit-learn, Polars, pandas, FastAPI, Celery, Redis, Optuna.
- 36 built-in pipeline nodes; exports any canvas pipeline to a Jupyter notebook.
- Integration templates for MLflow and Databricks.
- Runs locally with `docker compose up`; data never leaves your machine.
